title: Twilight Forest Portal
description: A Twilight Forest portal that has been replaced with a green transport medium
body:
Title: 💚 What if the Twilight Forest portal was green instead of purple?

Before: Magical purple
After: Fresh emerald green ✨

I swapped the original purple portal effect for a deep forest green. Now it looks more like a natural gateway into a forgotten wilderness. Perfect if you're tired of purple and want a calmer, more organic vibe.

(Just a visual change – no performance issues, no gameplay changes.)
